# RootBase: ModMind Agentic Stack

RootBase is a high-autonomy, agentic ecosystem designed for resilient, non-KYC revenue generation and autonomous development.

## 📁 Directory Structure
- `src/saas/`: Business-logic agents (Mrs. Higgins)
- `src/swarm/`: Agentic intelligence (Janebot, Molt)
- `src/cli/`: ModMind command interface
- `src/sync/`: Valet synchronization engine
- `docs/`: Technical architecture documentation

## 🚀 Getting Started
1. Set up your `.env` with required API keys (`GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `VOLTAGE_URL`, etc.).
2. Use `python main.py` to initialize the swarm.
3. Access internal controls via `/godmode`, `/dev`, or `/superdebug`.
